preservedResponsibilities: Original complete CSS1 token/state/selector values, linked selector/expression fields, reset/operator/length contracts and native URL/Color operations. CSS1Expression out parameters use ordinary JS reference cells or actual mutable Color values; UTF16 views adapt immutable strings to existing SAL/o3tl. Source color and lexer quirks are preserved as WRITER160..165. Native allocator/ABI, out-of-domain floating casts and compiled full Writer parity are not claimed.
omittedResponsibilities: Document CSS cascade/application, unrepresented HTML objects, native allocator/ABI and compiled Writer parity remain unverified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Native parcss1.hxx declarations and inline expression contracts have a TypeScript header owner; the scanner/grammar remain in parcss1.ts.
